title: AccountTransactionRequest
description: Represents the request for account details.

accountNumber.description: The account number associated with the account. Must be between 10 and 14 characters.

routingNumber.description: The routing number associated with the account. Must be exactly 9 characters.

startRangeOfDate.description: Start range of transaction posted date. It would be in yyyy-MM-dd format.

endRangeOfDate.description: End range of transaction posted date. It would be in yyyy-MM-dd format.

limit.description: Total number of transaction(s) records to return (should be in multiple of 100).

nextKey.description: This field can be used by the consumers to fetch the records from a specific page.  This value is returned as part of the response indicating the key for the next page.
